prompts.applies_when: Interior contractors and design-build studios that take residential or shop fit-out work and may be listed as a 시공업체 on 오늘의집. A design-only studio with no construction listing is often absent.
prompts.question: Does 오늘의집 list this business as a 시공업체, and do the rating, contract-verified review count, address, and 전문건설업 badge match what the business says?
prompts.why_it_matters: Owners rarely watch this quote app, so an old address, a low rating, or a missing 전문건설업 badge can sit there while the studio's own site says something else.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the Korean business name with site:ohou.se and read the top results. A contractor profile is under /experts/ and shows the trading name, a star rating, a count of reviews whose contracts the platform says it checked, an address, and a 전문건설업 badge when it has matched a specialty-construction registration. Tested on 홈앤안목 인테리어: the profile returned rating 4.8, 67 reviews, 서울특별시 은평구 갈현로 164, and the 전문건설업 badge.
prompts.found_when: An /experts/ profile names the business and shows a rating, review count, address, or 전문건설업 badge that the business does not show, or that disagrees with its own address or licence claim.
prompts.not_found_when: The top results are lifestyle articles, product pages, or user photos, and no /experts/ profile uses the business name. Absence is normal for studios that do not take jobs through this app.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The same host returns an advice article or a homestyling photo that merely mentions the name, the name is shared by another expert, or the page is only an app-login shell with no rating or address.

prompts.applies_when: Interior design studios and interior architects who may have entered the professional Golden Scale award. Student works from 대한민국 실내건축대전 are a different list and name people, not studios.
prompts.question: Is this studio named as a winner of the 한국실내건축가협회 골든스케일베스트디자인어워드, and for which year and project?
prompts.why_it_matters: A studio can have won this association prize and never put it on its site, or it can claim the prize when the winner pages name a different studio.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the Korean studio name with site:kosid.or.kr. Winner pages are split by year: https://kosid.or.kr/84 holds the 2018-2023 tabs and https://kosid.or.kr/89 holds the 2012-2017 tabs. A hit is the studio name under 대상 or 협회상, next to a project title and a year. The studio name is sometimes broken across two lines. Ignore /292, /78, /75, and /72, which are the student 실내건축대전 and list personal names. Tested on 수퍼파이 디자인 스튜디오: site search returned /84, 2019 협회상, project COFFEE MYUNGGA, designer 박재우.
prompts.found_when: A Golden Scale page names the studio beside a prize, year, and project that the studio does not mention, or the studio claims this award and no winner line names it.
prompts.not_found_when: No Golden Scale winner line names the studio. Most studios have not won, so absence is normal.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The only hits are student-competition posts that list personal names, the match is only a fragment of a studio name, or a different studio shares the name.

prompts.applies_when: Interior contractors and remodeling firms that may have joined the Korea Remodeling Association. The same directory also lists architecture offices and furniture firms, so the 사업분야 line has to be read.
prompts.question: Does a 한국리모델링협회 member page name this business, and do the phone, address, representative, and 사업분야 agree with the business?
prompts.why_it_matters: The member page can keep an old phone, address, or trade description after the firm has changed them on its own site.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the Korean business name with site:www.remodeling.or.kr and open a member_view.vm result. Read 회원사명, 주소, 대표자, 대표전화, 홈페이지, grade (S/A/B/C/D), and 사업분야. Tested on ㈜동성사: the B-grade page lists 경기 구리시 아차산로367번길 29 (교문동) 2층, 대표 윤태일, 031-554-9955, http://dongsungsa.com/, and 사업분야 실내건축공사 / 가구장식부품.
prompts.found_when: A member page names the business and shows a phone, address, representative, homepage, or 사업분야 that differs from the business's own site, or a membership the business does not mention.
prompts.not_found_when: No member_view page names the business. Membership is voluntary, so absence is normal.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: A short or common name matches a different member, the hit is a news post rather than a member record, or 사업분야 is architecture or furniture and not interior work.

prompts.applies_when: Interior architects and studio principals shown on the KOSID public partner strip. This is not the full member roll of the association.
prompts.question: Is this studio named on the 한국실내건축가협회 public partner page, and under which principal?
prompts.why_it_matters: The public page can show a studio name or principal the business no longer uses, or a partnership the business never mentions.
prompts.how_to_query: Read this one page. It pairs a principal with a studio, sometimes with a website link. Names on the page include 김대성 / 디자인 토큰, 허혁 / (주)디자인투모로우, and 조현이 / 큐빅디자인연구소. It is a short public showcase. The association does not publish the full member list on this page. Tested by searching 큐빅디자인연구소: the name returned on /16 next to 조현이.
prompts.found_when: The studio name appears next to a principal, which can confirm a KOSID partnership the studio does not mention or a studio name that differs from the current trading name.
prompts.not_found_when: The studio is not in this short strip. Most members are not shown, so absence is normal and is not evidence that the studio is not a member.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The page loads without the partner names, or a personal name matches while the studio name does not.

prompts.applies_when: Space, environmental, and interior design studios that could be selected as a 우수디자인전문기업. The same list also names product, graphic, and UX studios, which are outside this trade.
prompts.question: Is this studio on the current 한국디자인진흥원 우수디자인전문기업 list for 2025-2027, and which design field is it listed under?
prompts.why_it_matters: The selection is a two-year public designation with a published field and website, and a studio can claim it, or hold it, without the claim and the list matching.
prompts.how_to_query: Read this one announcement. It names about 20 firms, valid 2025-11-14 to 2027-12-31, split into 선도 (10) and 유망 (10), each with a design field and a website. Interior-relevant fields are 공간·환경디자인, 공간디자인, and 실내건축디자인. Tested on (주)이음파트너스, listed under 선도 as 공간·환경디자인 with http://www.yieum.com/. The same page also names 주식회사 디자인마인드플러스 under 유망 as 환경디자인 and 실내건축디자인. Older cycles are different posts and are not this page.
prompts.found_when: The business name is in the 선도 or 유망 list with a field or website the business does not publish, or the business claims the current 2025-2027 selection and is not named.
prompts.not_found_when: The name is not among the firms on this page. Only about twenty firms are selected, so absence is normal.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The board page returns an empty shell or a login wall, or the name matches a graphic or product studio on the list rather than an interior studio.

open_questions: The national 실내건축공사업 register and the official 시공능력평가 ranking are said to be published by KOSCA and KISCON, but neither could be read by company name without a form, and no official ranking file that names firms such as 국보디자인 was opened.
Local-government CSVs of 실내건축공사업 (용산구 and others on data.go.kr, and the 전국인테리어업체표준데이터) look free, but the rows were not in the catalog page, so they were not used.
